header: The title's attract demos, recorded into src/rt64_shaders.txt after tools/shader_plan.json, whose start presses
through the title: node lib/N64Recomp-browser/tools/record_shaders.mjs tools/shader_plan_demos.json build/web
roms/ddgq.us.z64 src/rt64_shaders.txt --add. Left at the title, the game plays a demo of six levels in turn, about
40 s each: city_2_b, haunted_3_1, haunted_3_4, haunted_3_b, inca_4_2 and trail. They draw some of their levels'
shaders with other flags than a player's game does, and inca_4_2's goes further than the plan's walk. Each section
is a load that waits at the title, picks its demo to play first (tools/survey.js's demo()) and records it to its
end into the section of its level, which a demo builds when it draws the level, as a player's game does. Its demo
plays first since the page prints a shader once a load: one an earlier demo drew would not print again.
